items.name: server_catalog_version_diff
items.description: Structured server surface diff between supported released catalog versions. fromVersion/toVersion accept v-prefixed or v-less semver; toVersion also accepts current/latest. First supported pair: v2.3.1 -> v2.3.2/current.

items.name: server_catalog_prompts_page
items.description: Paginated slice of the server prompt catalog. Same shape as roslyn://server/catalog/tools/{offset}/{limit}.

items.name: server_catalog_tools_page
items.description: Paginated slice of the server tool catalog. offset: 0-based start index; limit: 1-200 entries per page. Response carries offset/limit/returnedCount/totalCount/hasMore + the entries array.

items.name: workspace_diagnostics
items.description: Get diagnostics for a loaded workspace, capped at 500 entries (Warning floor by default — Info diagnostics are excluded). For full pagination control or to include Info, use the project_diagnostics tool. Workspace-scoped URI; see roslyn://server/resource-templates.

items.name: source_file
items.description: Read the source text of a file in the loaded workspace. filePath accepts URL-encoded form (recommended for cross-client portability — Windows absolute paths contain `:` and `\` which are reserved in URI grammar) or a raw absolute path; both are normalized server-side. Forward slashes are converted to the platform separator. For a line range, use the sibling template roslyn://workspace/{workspaceId}/file/{filePath}/lines/{startLine}-{endLine}.

items.name: source_file_lines
items.description: Read a 1-based inclusive line range from a file in the loaded workspace. filePath accepts URL-encoded form (recommended for cross-client portability — Windows absolute paths contain `:` and `\` which are reserved in URI grammar) or a raw absolute path; both are normalized server-side. Forward slashes are converted to the platform separator. lineRange is "startLine-endLine" (e.g. /lines/100-200). The response is prefixed with a comment marker noting the slice. For the whole file, use the sibling template without /lines/. Invalid ranges (e.g. non-numeric, endLine < startLine, or startLine past EOF) fail the read with a JSON-RPC InvalidParams (-32602) error — no C# MIME success body is returned.

items.name: workspace_projects
items.description: Get the project dependency graph and project metadata for a workspace. Requires workspaceId from workspace_load; see roslyn://server/resource-templates for the URI pattern.

items.name: workspace_status
items.description: Get a lean summary of a loaded workspace's status (counts and load state, no per-project tree). For the verbose payload use roslyn://workspace/{workspaceId}/status/verbose. URI uses the workspace_status template; see roslyn://server/resource-templates if your client does not list template URIs.

items.name: workspace_status_verbose
items.description: Verbose variant of roslyn://workspace/{workspaceId}/status — returns the full per-project tree and workspace diagnostics for the workspace. Prefer the summary resource at roslyn://workspace/{workspaceId}/status unless you need the full payload.
